## Avery Santana — Mayor

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-mayor/`
- **Address:** File legislative text for INIT-009 and INIT-010 with the City Clerk and docket formal administrative responses to the three standing citizen petitions.
- **Why:** INIT-009 (Commercial Stabilization for Grand Lake) and INIT-010 (West Oakland Tenant Defense Fund) were announced with legislation-filed milestones set for C110 and sit unfiled heading into the C112 stall threshold, while three verified citizen petitions have crossed the visibility line with no executive proposal introduced.
- **Acceptance:** Formal filing of draft ordinances for INIT-009 and INIT-010, alongside a recorded mayoral action on the three pending petition items in C112.
- **Silence consequence:** Both initiatives lapse into administrative stall under charter tracking, and executive inaction on verified citizen petitions becomes the city record.

## Nina Chen — City Council District 8

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-council-d8/`
- **Address:** Introduce the legislative ordinance for INIT-009 and file an immediate commercial corridor relief request for Grand Lake and Adams Point.
- **Why:** INIT-009 remains stalled at announced status past its C110 milestone with the C112 clock expiring, while Grand Lake registers severe decay signals (sentiment 0.25, retail vitality drop of 1.91) and Adams Point carries a decay momentum of 3 with sentiment at 0.20.
- **Acceptance:** Introduction of the INIT-009 ordinance text or a docketed committee referral for District 8 merchant stabilization observable in C112.
- **Silence consequence:** INIT-009 expires on the clock, leaving Grand Lake and Adams Point retail corridors without municipal stabilization funding.

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-council-d1/`
- **Address:** Co-sponsor and file the ordinance for INIT-010 and submit a municipal service plan for the Brooklyn commercial corridor.
- **Why:** INIT-010 sits at announced status with its C110 filing milestone missed and C112 stall clock closing, while Brooklyn records sentiment of 0.21, a crime index of 0.60, and a decay momentum of 4.
- **Acceptance:** Co-sponsorship and filing of the INIT-010 Tenant Defense Fund ordinance with the City Clerk, plus a filed service audit for Brooklyn in C112.
- **Silence consequence:** Tenant defense legislation fails to reach committee before the C112 clock expires, and Brooklyn's commercial vitality (7.63) deteriorates without intervention.

## Leonard Tran — City Council District 2

- **Agent:** `.claude/agents/civic-office-council-d2/`
- **Address:** Set the committee hearing schedule for INIT-008 and submit the independent oversight verification for INIT-006 Phase II remediation.
- **Why:** The $15M Downtown Economic Revitalization ordinance (INIT-008) was filed in C110 and requires committee action by C112, while INIT-006 faces its C112 milestone review and Baylight District sentiment sits at 0.30 with retail vitality at 5.72.
